summary.name: Photon
summary.one_liner: Photon is a free, open-source screenshot, markup and screen recording app for Mac and Windows, written in Rust.
use_cases: capture a region or window on macOS
pin a screenshot above other windows
summary.what_it_does: Photon takes screenshots by pressing ⇧⌘9 on Mac or Ctrl+Shift+9 on Windows, which freezes the screens at full resolution. You can drag over an area, click a window to select it, or click the desktop for the full screen, then adjust the selection with handles or arrow keys; a badge shows the size in pixels. You can mark up the capture, press Return to copy it, or use the action bar to save it as PNG or JPEG, print it, or pin it above other windows. Per the page description, it also records screen video at 60 fps, trims clips and makes GIFs. Esc cancels at any point.
notable: Open source and written in Rust
No network code, per the awesome-mac listing
Pixel-size badge while selecting a capture area
Can pin screenshots above other windows
caveats: Screen recording, trimming and GIF features are only described in the meta description, not demonstrated in the page text
